about.title: Who we are
about.lead: My name is Saphira (Phia) Pinas (42) and together with my partner Dwight Krenten (44) we are the founders and owners of Phia’s Smulparadijs.
about.body:
Phia’s Smulparadijs grew out of my great passion for cooking and my love for Surinamese and Caribbean cuisine. Entrepreneurship is a passion Dwight and I both share, and by joining forces Phia’s Smulparadijs was born.

Since 2016 we have been a proud family business, specialised in the Surinamese-Creole kitchen. We do this wholeheartedly, under our motto: ‘Come and enjoy the Surinamese-Creole kitchen!’

With us, everything is cooked fresh every day, with love and passion. Quality and flavour come first; that is what we guarantee you. In our dishes we combine authentic flavours, creativity and craftsmanship, and above all a lot of joy in what we do.

Our takeaway meals are available in our Smulparadijs at Bouwlustlaan 111 in The Hague. We are proud to say that Phia’s Smulparadijs is the first Surinamese-Creole eatery in The Hague and its surroundings.
about.section1Heading: Nothing is finer than turning your hobby into your profession
about.section1Text: With that goal, and our dream of starting our own business, we began Phia’s Smulparadijs.
about.section2Text: With our knowledge, experience and motivation, we are convinced that Phia’s Smulparadijs will be a success. In this business we work with HACCP- and allergen-knowledge-certified staff.
